_about: GM. Tracks made ahead for an Annals song or rhyme the page has not sung. Each file waits in saga/state/_gm/songs/ until the Codex has an entry by `name` under Songs and verses and the chapters have sung every line it embeds; then `saga.py record` (or `songs release`) moves it to saga/art/songs/ and adds {name, audio, audio_title} to codex_art.json. Never edited by hand: `saga.py songs add`.

waiting.name: Salt Goes Up
lines: Salt goes up and the letters come down,
stone after stone out of Calden town,
and the road gives way to a cart with a bell,
and a cart with none has a tale to tell.
Salt goes up and the letters come down,
and the farms hear the bell before I come round,
and they come to the gate with their hands in their shawls,
and it's only salt, and that's all, that's all.

waiting.name: Whose Are You
lines: Whose are you, whose are you,
Which bell do you sleep by,
Mill bell, inn bell, bell on the tarn,
one for the fair and two for the barn,
three for the carter who's never in bed,
and out goes the one with the fog in her head!
